item.title: Goals key as Mayo deal Galway opening defeat in Salthill
item.description: Mayo got their first competitive win under manager Andy Moran after edging out Galway by 3-18 to 2-18 in an entertaining derby clash in Salthill.

item.title: Armagh make impressive start with 12-point win over Monaghan
item.description: Armagh proved too strong for Monaghan in this afternoon's Allianz Football League Division 1 opening round clash in Clones.

item.title: Dingle vows to repay support to Geelong
item.description: Newly-crowned All-Ireland club football champions Dingle will be fully behind Geelong when the new AFL season commences in March.

item.title: Controversial new rule raises O'Connor's ire
item.description: Jack O'Connor has blasted the new rule which sees the ball being brought forward 50 metres if a player doesn't hand it back after committing a foul.

item.title: Laois GAA club devastated at player's sudden passing
item.description: A GAA club in Laois has been left shocked and saddened at the passing of one of its most talented players.

item.title: Moran hails 'big win' over Galway
item.description: On a cold January's day in Salthill, Andy Moran warmly welcomed Mayo's first win over Galway in five attempts.

item.title: Team-work pleases new Cork hurling boss
item.description: Ben O'Connor cut a contented figure after his new Cork charges opened their Allianz Hurling League defence with a rousing 3-25 to 1-17 victory over Waterford at SuperValu Páirc Uí Chaoimh.

item.title: 'Technically, it was the correct call'
item.description: Eamonn Fitzmaurice believes Kerry's contentious buzzer-beating winner against Roscommon was the right call.

item.title: Sigerson and Fitzgibbon Cup finals to be played in Croke Park
item.description: The GAA Higher Education committee has announced that the finals of the Sigerson and Fitzgibbon Cups will return to Croke Park for the first time in 40 years this February.
